title: Connectors
subtitle: Give your agent access to the services you already use. No technical setup required.

setup.title: Connect your apps
setup.description: Add a Composio project key once. Claw OS keeps it outside the visible app interface and creates the agent connection automatically.
setup.secure: Your key stays on this device and is never shown again.

reset.title: Change the Composio key?
reset.description: Claw OS will remove this local session and ask for a project key again. Your connected accounts remain in Composio.

error: We couldn't load connectors. Check your Composio key and try again.

toast.reset: Composio is ready for a new key.
